_remarks.file_purpose: Runtime controls for AirSim train/visualize behavior used by fw.main_with_airsim.
_remarks.json_note: JSON does not support comments, so remarks are stored in _remarks blocks.
_remarks.routing_note: fw.config chooses env_type/action; this file refines AirSim behavior once AirSimEnv is selected.

_remarks.model_visualise: true => visualize framework-model replay in UE5.
_remarks.model_family: Model visualiser family selector for run_visualise_models (auto|pysim|fhsim).
_remarks.inference_visualise: true => run UE5 inference model visualization.
_remarks.mode_priority: If both model_visualise and inference_visualise are true, model_visualise wins.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for visualize entry points.
_remarks.render_interpolation_steps: Higher values smooth mirrored motion but can increase visual overhead.
_remarks.show_minimap: Enable or disable the UE5 top-down minimap during model visualization.
_remarks.throttle_visual_gain: Scales mirrored throttle so UE5 visual propulsion matches the framework replay speed envelope. 5.0/5.6 is the calibrated default for the current ship.

_remarks.speed_profile: normal|safe|fast|turbo|custom. 'safe' is the recommended starting point for new AirSim training runs because it keeps lock-step stepping conservative and debuggable.
_remarks.simulation_speed: UE5 simulation speed multiplier during training.
_remarks.draw_calibration_reference: true => draw the same calibration ridges, route line, and start/end markers as visualization mode.
_remarks.no_rendering_mode: true => disable UE5 scene rendering during training while keeping physics active.
_remarks.load_world_on_start: true => issue one save-slot world reload during training startup, then keep all later episode resets pose-based. This is the recommended way to force the simulator_1 spawn state once without reloading on every reset.
_remarks.capture_live_start_pose: true => after the one-shot startup load settles, adopt that live simulator spawn pose and heading as the training reset anchor for all later respawns.
_remarks.episode_log_path: Optional CSV path for per-step AirSim training telemetry. Useful when training headless.
_remarks.max_policy_updates: Number of PPO policy updates to run in the standalone AirSim training path.
_remarks.normalize_reward: true => scale the shaped environment reward into [-1, 1] before PPO consumes it.
_remarks.reward_normalization_scale: Absolute reward scale used for clipping into [-1, 1].
_remarks.reset_mode: rewind_pose => teleport back to the route start without a bridge reset. bridge_reset => call the heavier AirSim reset path first.
_remarks.progress_log_interval_steps: Print a concise training heartbeat every N AirSim steps. Set 0 to disable.
_remarks.log_pause_watchdog_warnings: true => print pause watchdog timeout warnings during lock-step training. false keeps training output clean.
_remarks.use_sim_time_stepping: true => when paused training is enabled, advance by simulation time instead of frame count.
_remarks.sim_time_per_action: Simulation seconds advanced for each RL action when sim-time stepping is enabled. This maps directly to AirSim's simContinueForTime(seconds) RPC.
_remarks.use_pause_stepping: true => deterministic paused stepping. For the current car-physics PPO setup, combine this with use_sim_time_stepping so one RL step has a fixed simulated duration.
_remarks.frames_per_step: How many UE5 physics frames are advanced per RL step when frame stepping is explicitly selected.
_remarks.time_step: Nominal RL step duration. For car-physics PPO training this should match sim_time_per_action so one RL step equals one explicit amount of simulated time.
_remarks.physics_update_timeout: Watchdog while waiting for frame-step completion.
_remarks.state_poll_interval: Polling cadence while waiting for UE5 to re-pause.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for AirSim training.
_remarks.curriculum_enabled: false => train directly on the full AirSim route without staged curriculum starts.
_remarks.control_interface: Current UE5 control interface. Keep 'car_physics' for the existing car-based AirSim controls; future hydro models can introduce new interfaces later.
_remarks.observation_profile: Current PPO observation contract. 'ppo_route_relative_car' keeps the observation route-relative while exposing turn-rate and cross-track trend cues needed for tighter AirSim route tracking.
_remarks.guidance_assist_enabled: false is recommended for PPO research/training stability so the policy acts directly on the environment without a hidden helper controller.
_remarks.steering_dynamics_enabled: true => apply vessel-like steering dynamics (low-pass + slew-rate) before controls are sent to UE5.
_remarks.steering_smoothing_alpha: Low-pass blend factor in [0,1] for steering. Higher values track policy faster; lower values are smoother.
_remarks.max_steering_rate_per_second: Maximum absolute steering change per simulated second in normalized [-1,1] steering space.

_remarks.use_airsim: Master on/off switch for AirSim bridge usage.
_remarks.ip: AirSim RPC host. Empty string means localhost.
_remarks.save_slot: UE5 save slot loaded before training/visualization.
_remarks.simulation_speed: Base UE5 speed used by visualize path and as fallback when training overrides are absent.
